```patch
insert after Catalog.query
  state sortByPrice = false
replace Catalog.shown
  computed shown = products.filter(p => p.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())).slice().sort((a, b) => sortByPrice ? a.price - b.price : 0)
insert after Catalog/column/input
  button "Ordenar por precio" primary=sortByPrice -> sortByPrice = true
```

```patch
append Catalog
  state sortByPrice = false
replace Catalog.shown
  computed shown = (() => {
    const list = products.filter(p => p.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()))
    return sortByPrice ? list.sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price) : list
  })()
insert after Catalog/column/input
  button "Ordenar por precio" small -> sortByPrice = true
```
